title: David Spares Saul Again

questions.question: Who again told Saul where David was hiding?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:1 (ESV): “Then the Ziphites came to Saul... saying, ‘Is not David hiding...?’”

questions.question: Who went with David into Saul’s camp at night?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:6-7 (ESV): “...And Abishai said, ‘I will go down with you.’ So David and Abishai went to the army by night.”

questions.question: What did Abishai want to do to Saul?
options: Pin him to the earth with one strike of the spear
questions.correctAnswer: Pin him to the earth with one strike of the spear
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:8 (ESV): “...‘Now please let me pin him to the earth with one stroke of the spear...’”

questions.question: What did David take from Saul’s head?
options: The spear and the jar of water
questions.correctAnswer: The spear and the jar of water
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:12 (ESV): “So David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul’s head, and they went away.”

questions.question: Why did no one wake up?
options: A deep sleep from the Lord had fallen upon them
questions.correctAnswer: A deep sleep from the Lord had fallen upon them
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:12 (ESV): “...because a deep sleep from the Lord had fallen upon them.”

questions.question: Who did David rebuke for not guarding the king?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:15 (ESV): "And David said to Abner... 'Why have you not kept watch over your lord the king?'"

questions.question: What did Saul confess after David spoke to him?
options: I have sinned... I have played the fool
I will catch you next time
questions.correctAnswer: I have sinned... I have played the fool
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:21 (ESV): "...I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly."

questions.question: Where did David stand to call out to Abner?
options: On the top of the hill afar off
questions.correctAnswer: On the top of the hill afar off
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:13 (ESV): "Then David went over to the other side and stood on the top of the hill afar off..."

questions.question: David compared the king of Israel to one hunting a ______ in the mountains.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:20 (ESV): "...like one who hunts a partridge in the mountains."

questions.question: Did David return the spear?
options: Yes, he told a young man to fetch it
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, he told a young man to fetch it
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:22 (ESV): "David answered... 'Here is the king's spear; let one of the young men come over and take it.'"

questions.question: David said the Lord would repay every man for his ______ and his ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:23 (ESV): "The LORD rewards every man for his righteousness and his faithfulness..."

questions.question: Who was Ahimelech the Hittite?
options: One of the men David asked to go with him (but didn't go)
questions.correctAnswer: One of the men David asked to go with him (but didn't go)
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:6 (ESV): "David said to Ahimelech the Hittite and to Joab's brother Abishai... 'Who will go down with me?'"

questions.question: Abishai was the son of ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:6 (ESV): "...Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother..."

questions.question: David said if men have stirred Saul up, they are ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 26:19 (ESV): "...but if it is men, may they be cursed before the LORD..."

questions.question: What imply did David say by claiming he was driven out from the heritage of the Lord?
options: They are saying, "Go, serve other gods"
questions.correctAnswer: They are saying, "Go, serve other gods"

key_verse_text: The LORD rewards every man for his righteousness and his faithfulness, for the LORD gave you into my hand today, and I would not put out my hand against the LORD’s anointed. (ESV)
